subject: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@alphatech.com>; Procurement Ops <procurement@alphatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Jun 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)

Hi Sofia / procurement team —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion, I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) for the AlphaTech evaluation and procurement window (attachment: AlphaTech_MAP_draft_v1.pdf). Key points I outlined:

- Target commercial close: proposing 2026-06-30 to align with AlphaTech Q2 budget.
- Procurement signature runway: asking for signed SOW by 2026-06-24 to allow internal finance & onboarding prep.
- Milestone owners:
  - Redwood SOW + commercial: Karthik Iyer
  - Technical sandbox / PoC: Marissa Cole
  - Legal redlines: Ben Carter
- Dependencies: SOC 2 report availability, security questionnaire completion, and a final SOW with signature block.

Could you confirm the internal signatory and whether the 06/24 procurement cutoff is feasible? If not, please propose the earliest realistic signature date and any internal gating items we should put on the MAP.

Next steps I propose:
1) We deliver a signature‑ready SOW and SOC2 snapshot by EOD 2026-06-10.
2) Procurement runs legal review; target sign by 2026-06-24 or indicate a new sign date.
3) Technical kickoff / sandbox access scheduled the week after signature.

Copying Marissa and Ben to own the technical and legal items. I can jump on a quick 20‑minute alignment call if it helps accelerate.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachment: AlphaTech_MAP_draft_v1.pdf

From: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@alphatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@alphatech.com>; Maya Singh <maya.singh@alphatech.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)

Hi Karthik —

Appreciate the clear MAP; the structure is helpful. A few notes from procurement/legal:

- Our org typically needs ~2 weeks for legal plus SLAs review once we have a final SOW and evidence (SOC2). That puts a realistic earliest signature around 2026-07-15 if we wait for our standard cycle.
- If Redwood can provide the SOC2 snapshot and a signature‑ready SOW (no open commercial terms) by 2026-06-10, we can attempt an expedited path, but I need explicit confirmation from our legal lead (Maya) and procurement ops.
- Our main internal gating items: vendor security evidence, SOW with indemnity/liability sections reviewed, and a populated procurement checklist (I've attached the checklist).

For transparency, I included procurement@alphatech. I’ll ping Maya for her availability to approve an expedited review.

Best,
Sofia
Sofia Alvarez
Senior Procurement Manager | AlphaTech

Attachment: alphatech_procurement_checklist.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@alphatech.com>
Date: Wed, 03 Jun 2026 10:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)

Thanks — quick alignment from Redwood side. Two parallel approaches to give AlphaTech flexibility:

Option A (Aggressive - keep 06/30 close):
- Redwood delivers: signature‑ready SOW + SOC2 snapshot + filled procurement checklist by EOD 06/10. (Owner: Karthik)
- Redwood legal (Ben) to prepare a minimal redline playbook to reduce negotiation cycles.
- Technical: deliver sandbox access and a prioritized short PoC plan by 06/15 (Owner: Marissa).
- Redwood offers a commercial credit reserve (small window) if legal needs a day extension during signing to maintain onboarding timeline.

Option B (Conservative - shift close):
- Move commercial close to 07/15 to align with AlphaTech standard legal cycle.
- Keep MAP milestones the same but shift dates; focus on delivering technical readiness earlier so internal stakeholders see progress.

Ask from us: Sofia, if you can indicate which option procurement prefers (A to try expedite vs B to go standard), we’ll lock owners and build the exact milestone dates into the MAP.

I’ll start drafting the condensed PoC plan for 06/08 and coordinate with Ben on the redline playbook.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@alphatech.com>; Procurement Ops <procurement@alphatech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)

Sofia / procurement team —

Thanks for the context. We’ll commit to the aggressive playbook and deliverables to try to keep the June 30 target, with the caveat that we need procurement to circulate any legal redlines the moment they appear so we can triage quickly. Specific commitments: 

- Redwood will deliver a signature‑ready SOW and a SOC2 snapshot (latest report PDF + SOC2 scope note) by EOD 2026-06-10. (Owner: Karthik)
- Ben will prepare the Redwood redline playbook and a proposed short-form SOW to reduce back-and-forth by 2026-06-09. (Owner: Ben Carter)
- Marissa will publish the 2‑week sandbox PoC plan and invite AlphaTech engineers by 2026-06-08. (Owner: Marissa Cole)

Sofia — can you please confirm the preferred contract signatory (name & title) and who will be the primary point of contact for DocuSign? If procurement confirms they can turn a completed SOW around within 72 hours of receipt (with one round of legal comments at most), we’ll keep 06/30 as the commercial close target and set procurement signature milestone at 06/24.

I’m happy to open a 20‑minute slot tomorrow to run through the SOW checklist together.

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Maya Singh <maya.singh@alphatech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>; Sofia Alvarez <sofia.alvarez@alphatech.com>
Cc: Procurement Ops <procurement@alphatech.com>; Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP, procurement signature runway, and target close proposals (AlphaTech)

Hi Karthik, Sofia —

Thanks for the note and proposed options. I’ll attempt an expedited review provided we receive the final SOW and SOC2 snapshot by EOD 2026-06-10. My team agrees to aim for a procurement signature milestone of 2026-06-24, contingent on:

- Final SOW delivered with fully populated commercial terms and no open placeholders.
- SOC2 snapshot attached and the filled procurement checklist returned.
- DocuSign contact: Procurement Ops will be the envelope owner; please address DocuSign to "Procurement Ops <procurement@alphatech.com>".

If any of the above misses the 06/10 delivery, we will revert to the standard timeframe and propose a 07/15 signature.

Maya Singh
Senior Counsel | AlphaTech
